name: AD group member
packageArguments: Base64-encoded UTF-8 JSON object, run on a domain controller. {"User":"jdoe@example.com","Group":"Staff","ExpiresInDays":"7"} adds jdoe to Staff and registers a task that removes the membership in 7 days, then deletes itself. "ExpiresOn":"yyyy-MM-dd" sets a date instead. Leave both out for a lasting membership. Add "Section":"Evidence" for a read-only check. Uninstall removes the membership and the task. Privileged groups and users not in AD are refused.
